vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="1118" y="270" width="455" height="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="yDERKpb8CfEkE_r3Z8Gg-77" value="RPA Process&nbsp;PurposefulPromethium, <span style="background-color: rgb(181, 137, 0);">conceptual</span>&nbsp;code reorganization target<div><br></div><div><div><span style="font-weight: 400; background-color: initial;">Clear Checkpoints for Data Integrity:&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: initial; font-weight: 400;">Within the pipeline model approach of the REFramework, each transaction item is managed with an inner input-processing-output structure to ensure data consistency.</span></div><div><span style="font-weight: 400; background-color: initial;">During the </span><span style="background-color: initial;">Input</span><span style="font-weight: 400; background-color: initial;"> phase, items are prepared and validated, ensuring readiness before advancing. The </span><span style="background-color: initial;">Processing</span><span style="font-weight: 400; background-color: initial;">&nbsp;stage serves as the main checkpoint, where data verification and integrity checks are conducted to confirm that each item meets all necessary conditions before finalization. Additionally, data required for output is prepared here. Finally, the </span><span style="background-color: initial;">Output</span><span style="font-weight: 400; background-color: initial;"> phase performs the RPA-typical GUI automation steps.</span></div><div><span style="font-weight: 400; background-color: initial;">This structured approach is generally well-suited for low to medium complexity processes and effectively prevents bad data from progressing, maintaining data consistency across the workflow.</span></div><div><br></div></div>" div.div:
RPA Process PurposefulPromethium, conceptual code reorganization target
Clear Checkpoints for Data Integrity: Within the pipeline model approach of the REFramework, each transaction item is managed with an inner input-processing-output structure to ensure data consistency.
During the Input phase, items are prepared and validated, ensuring readiness before advancing. The Processing stage serves as the main checkpoint, where data verification and integrity checks are conducted to confirm that each item meets all necessary conditions before finalization. Additionally, data required for output is prepared here. Finally, the Output phase performs the RPA-typical GUI automation steps.
This structured approach is generally well-suited for low to medium complexity processes and effectively prevents bad data from progressing, maintaining data consistency across the workflow.
